note: Erste Bank Montenegro's general information on its Mastercard revolving credit card (dated 10 June 2026), read in full, with the card's page. The nominal rate is fixed, from 7.00% a year; the bank sets each holder's rate by creditworthiness and gives no top, so the rate of its representative example, 8.99% a year (a 2,000 euro limit, an effective 12.87%), is written. It costs 2.50 euros a month to hold (an additional card 1.50, not written); the minimum monthly payment is 3% of the amount used, at least 20 euros, plus interest and fees (the fees aren't modelled in the minimum); a cash withdrawal at Erste Bank's own machines in Montenegro costs 3%, at least 3 euros (4 euros at other machines, not modelled). The limit is 1,500 to 5,000 euros set by creditworthiness, not a multiple of income. Neither source states a late fee, penalty rate, grace period or foreign transaction fee; on late payment the bank may call the whole debt with default interest, which isn't one of the form's terms.
